## Our use of cookies

We use necessary cookies to make our site work. We’d also like to set optional analytics cookies to
help us improve it. We won’t set optional cookies unless you enable them. Using this tool will set a
cookie on your device to remember your preferences.

For more detailed information about the cookies we use, see our [Cookie policy][211]

Please adjust your preferences using the options below and save your preferences. Further
information in respect of the specific cookies we use is available in our [Cookie policy][212]

### Strictly necessary cookies

These cookies are required for the website to run. These cookies are always enabled because our
website won’t work properly without them. They include, for example, cookies that enable you to log
into secure areas of our website, or use a shopping cart. You can set your browser to block or turn
these cookies off, but all or part of our website may become inaccessible or not function correctly.

### Analytics cookies

These cookies allow us to recognise and count the number of visitors and to see how visitors move
around our website when they are using it. This helps us to improve the way our website works, for
example, by ensuring that users are finding what they are looking for easily. These cookies may
allocate a unique identifier to you so we can distinguish you from other website users whilst you
are browsing our website, please see our [Privacy Policy][213] for further information.

# Helping *Hometown* **Grocers**
# Across America Thrive

For more than 107 years, we’ve helped hometown grocers — from national chains to single-store
operators — serve their communities. Through innovative supply chain solutions, quality products and
services, and trusted retail experiences, we help keep shelves stocked and families fed across the
country.

## Our Stores & Services

### Financial Services

Discover how our comprehensive financial services, including payroll, accounts payable, tax
consulting and bookkeeping, help retailers save time and focus on growing their business.

[ About Financial Services ][80]

### Food Safety Services

As a food solutions company that has earned consumer trust for more than 107 years, C&S understands
the importance of having rigorous standards and training for food safety.

[ About Food Safety Services ][81]

### Marketing Services

C&S offers marketing support to elevate your brand, including cutting-edge technology and
industry-leading insights — all designed to enhance your promotional strategies, from digital
advertising to community engagement.

[ About Marketing Services ][82]

### Pharmacy Solutions

Our pharmacy services leverage collective buying power across 2,500 independent pharmacies to
guarantee lower operational costs for you and better health outcomes for the community you serve. 

[ About Pharmacy Solutions ][83]

### Our Stores

The C&S family of companies includes more than 200 grocery stores in 12 states, in addition to
dozens of pharmacies and fuel centers with convenience stores.

[ About Our Stores ][84]

### OurBrands

OurBrands are carried in company-operated stores and are distributed to our independent retail
customers — providing great products and great savings for every shopper and for every family.

[ About OurBrands ][85]

## Committed to Communities Beyond the Store

At C&S Wholesale Grocers, the families we serve are at the core of everything we do, from combating
hunger to safeguarding the environment. We collaborate with organizations nationwide to make a
lasting impact on the communities where we live and work.

The Gordon Now App lets you place orders, browse products, and manage your account right from your
mobile device.

[Learn More >][26]

Gordon Restaurant Pro helps you control costs, plan menus, and analyze sales data to maximize
profitability.

[Learn More >][27]

offerings.

[**Explore Support**][35]

businesses across North America.

maximize your efficiency.

The Gordon Now App lets you place orders, browse products, and manage your account right from your

profitability.

## A Trusted Leader
## In The Foodservice Industry

More than 100 years of experience and adaptation

We deliver success through a blend of proven expertise and willingness to embrace change. Yes, we
started delivering food in 1885, but we’ve never stopped moving or rested on our laurels. We are
always looking for fresh ideas, simple solutions and new ways to serve our customers, while using
the knowledge we’ve gained to streamline our operations and processes. That’s why our customers
count on us for safety and efficiency, but also to show them what’s coming next.




Jamie Guadagnino

## Developing Your Future

Jamie Guadagnino, Vice President of Sales, Vistar

Jamie Guadagnino began her journey with PFG over 20 years ago as a Customer Service Representative.
She advanced through a variety of positions over the years and through hard work and commitment, she
is now Vice President of Sales, Vistar.

I value the trust and investment that PFG places in my development. I still have much to learn in my
current role, and look forward to working here for many more years to come.

## Careers

Find the right job

PFG is a great place to start and build a career. We hire in a variety of fields.

** Drivers
** Warehouse
** Sales
** Finance
** Supply Chain
** Marketing
** Human Resources
** Information Technology
** Procurement

[Search For Jobs ][25]

### Delivering Success With A Focus On Innovation

We find flexible, efficient solutions for our customers


Everything we do is built around ensuring our customers’ businesses thrive. We started delivering
food in 1885 and over the years have re-invented ourselves time and again to stay ahead of the
industry. That’s why our customers don’t just see us as order takers; they see us as success
makers.

## In The Foodservice Industry

More than 100 years of experience and adaptation

We deliver success through a blend of proven expertise and willingness to embrace change. Yes, we
started delivering food in 1885, but we’ve never stopped moving or rested on our laurels. We are
always looking for fresh ideas, simple solutions and new ways to serve our customers, while using
the knowledge we’ve gained to streamline our operations and processes. That’s why our customers
count on us for safety and efficiency, but also to show them what’s coming next.




Jamie Guadagnino

## Developing Your Future

Jamie Guadagnino, Vice President of Sales, Vistar

Jamie Guadagnino began her journey with PFG over 20 years ago as a Customer Service Representative.
She advanced through a variety of positions over the years and through hard work and commitment, she
is now Vice President of Sales, Vistar.

I value the trust and investment that PFG places in my development. I still have much to learn in my
current role, and look forward to working here for many more years to come.

international markets. Every biscuit we manufacture reflects our dedication to quality, hygiene, and
customer satisfaction. From sourcing premium ingredients to final packaging, every step follows
established quality procedures to deliver products that meet customer expectations. Our production
facility is equipped with modern biscuit manufacturing machinery designed to deliver consistent
quality and high production efficiency.

If you’re looking for a dependable biscuit manufacturer, private label biscuit supplier or OEM

# Baked to share
# and enjoy

[Our company][28]
[Our products][29]

## Excellent taste at great value

We are the leading private label biscuit and bread substitute manufacturer in Europe, with a rich
heritage of over 400 years of expertise in delivering excellent taste at great value. Our strong
market knowledge and geographical coverage along with our uniquely diverse portfolio and highly
skilled workforce offer unparalleled expertise and value to both our customers and partners. Our
operations encompass 30 factories, employing more than 5,000 people.

400+

years of experience in baking biscuits and bread substitutes

**#1**

in Europe

40+

markets presence

30

factories in Europe

[Find out about us][30]

### Our mission

As Europe’s leading private label biscuit and bread substitute manufacturer, we offer excellent
taste at great value with a uniquely diverse portfolio of products. Our historical know-how and
innovation & sustainability mindset drive us to be the best in our industry, constantly striving for
excellence.

Our vision is to **bake biscuits for people to share and enjoy** everywhere at their leisure.

[Know more][31]

## Our values

We share strong values as Europe’s leading
private label biscuit and bread substitute manufacturer

### ****We are accountable to all our stakeholders****

We work with an unwavering dedication to ensuring reliability at each step of our value chain.

### ****We promote integrity** **within our organisation****

By developing open and honest relationships. Facing challenges with transparency, we are creating an
environment of trust and mutual respect with our customers, partners, and employees.

### **We challenge ourselves to strive for excellence**

In all that we do, enabling us to exceed the expectations of all our stakeholders.

### **We embrace the power of simplicity**

In all aspects of our business, fostering a genuine connection with our employees and our customers.

### **We nurture a culture of teamwork**

Where collaboration and solidarity empower everyone to play a part in our success.


### Our product categories

With a rich heritage of over 400 years of expertise in delivering excellent taste at great value,

our uniquely diverse portfolio offers expertise to both our customers and partners.

  ### Sweet biscuits
  
  ][32]

  ][33]

  ][34]

  ][35]

  ### Specialties & seasonal
  
  ][36]
* [
  
  ### Dietary choices
  
  ][37]
* [
  
  ### Rice and corn cakes
  
  ][38]
* [
  
  ### Bread substitutes
  
  ][39]
* [
  
  ### Savoury
  
  ][40]

[Discover more][41]

## Our commitments

### People, environment and taste

As heirs of a rich historical heritage of more than 400 years, we take responsibility for fostering
and expanding our legacy for future generations. The importance of satisfying evolving customer
needs and consumer desires is at the heart of our activities. Our goal is to make biscuits for
people to share and enjoy at their leisure. As one of the leaders in our industry, we take
responsibility for supporting the health of our consumers and the environmental balance of the
planet.

[Know more][42]

******“**** *Working together in collaboration with partners, external advisors, regulators and
stakeholders, we focus on maximising our long-term positive impact.* *****”*******

– Leon Taviansky, Chief Executive Officer

## **Join us**

### Do you want to work for a leading European company with a “people first” attitude and
### sustainability at its core?

With 32 production facilities throughout Europe, we are committed to create a winning culture where
employees can work safely and unlock their full potential. We constantly drive change for the
better, whether that’s from a sourcing, safety or product angle. If you want to be part of the
exciting challenge of bringing tastier and healthier everyday products to the market, get in touch
today!

[Join us][43]

* ## Biscuit International continues its rebranding journey for its subsidiaries to support its
  ## growth ambitions.

and expanding our legacy for future generations. The importance of satisfying evolving customer
needs and consumer desires is at the heart of our activities. Our goal is to make biscuits for
people to share and enjoy at their leisure. As one of the leaders in our industry, we take
responsibility for supporting the health of our consumers and the environmental balance of the
planet.

[Know more][42]

******“**** *Working together in collaboration with partners, external advisors, regulators and
stakeholders, we focus on maximising our long-term positive impact.* *****”*******

– Leon Taviansky, Chief Executive Officer

## **Join us**

### Do you want to work for a leading European company with a “people first” attitude and
### sustainability at its core?

With 32 production facilities throughout Europe, we are committed to create a winning culture where
employees can work safely and unlock their full potential. We constantly drive change for the
better, whether that’s from a sourcing, safety or product angle. If you want to be part of the
exciting challenge of bringing tastier and healthier everyday products to the market, get in touch
today!

## BROWN'S BAKERY

An artisan bakery-cafe, Brown’s was born out of love for all things healthy, delicious & pure in
2017.

At Brown's, we aim to change the way India consumes bakery. To move away from the Margerine,
preservatives & chemical laden industry norm towards Al-Natural, Healthy, Pure butter,
Preservative-free Cookies, Tea Cakes, Breads & Snackibles; made with the highest quality ingredients
possible.

a neighbourhood café in Panipat, doubled in size on its second anniversary and has now become a
hallmark for artisanal breads, pure butter handmade cookies, delicious cakes and delectable food in
town.

# GET COOKING WITH CADBURY

Fancy baking some delicious Cadbury treats to share with family and friends? Cakes, cookies,
brownies and desserts all created by Cadbury and its fans!

[EXPLORE ALL RECIPES][52]

## NEW PRODUCT

Try new Cadbury &More Biscoff chocolate bar! It's a layered delight with creamy milk chocolate,
crumbled Biscoff biscuits, and a Biscoff spread centre.

[Discover more][53]
NEW LIMITED EDITION

## DAIRY MILK STRAWBERRIES & CREME FRAPPE BAR

It's made for sharing, giving you the perfect snack for summer celebrations.

[DISCOVER MORE][54]
COMPETITION

## HANG OUT WITH A FOOTBALL ICON

With Cadbury Win For your Squad, you and up to 10 friends are in with the chance of spending the day
with a football icon. With matchday tickets & daily prizes up for grabs too, buy a pack & scan for
your chance to win.

[ENTER NOW][55]
COMPETITION

## £100K WORTH OF CASH PRIZES

What's better than winning a cash prize? When you win and you nominate your local shop to win too.
For a chance to win, buy a bar, scan the pack, and enter your details on the link below. And if you
win, you both win.

[ENTER NOW][56]

## Indulge in the New Look

Cadbury &More Caramel Nut Crunch & Nutty Praline Crisp: now with new packaging! Enjoy the range.
Have you tried Cadbury &More Biscoff?

[Discover our range page][57]

# Brands

Sri Lanka’s best loved brands are leading the way by creating food with purpose

# Caring

Creating enriching moments of happiness for people everywhere

# Quality

Using only the best ingredients, we’re delivering value and satisfaction with every mouthful

# Innovation

We’re constantly exploring new ways to add value to every meal and snack in between

# Integrity

We are committed to doing business that is honest, ethical and responsible

CBL is a Sri Lankan food manufacturing conglomerate that produces high quality confectionery and
convenient nutrition. Our story started in 1968 with the protein enriched Care biscuit created in
collaboration between CBL, the Sri Lankan Government and CARE U.S.A., to combat malnutrition in
schoolchildren at the time. Since then, we have worked closely with communities in every part of the
country to understand food needs and to apply our core values to making food with purpose that truly
enriches lives.

[Learn More][69]

Food with purpose

Revitalizing the way we grow

Good for the planet

We are committed to making food we are proud of. We want our food to help build better nutrition
habits in our communities and we’re innovating new ways to create great food that our consumers can
trust. Using the best ingredients and more and more locally grown, fresh produce in our recipes
we’re taking our products to new heights every day in safety, quality and taste and, helping people
make informed good food choices at every meal of the day.

We are committed to creating stability and increased access to growth opportunities for our farmers
by making them active partners in the growth of their communities. Our dedicated agriculture teams
support our 13,000+ farmer base and their families to grow through guaranteed purchasing and
pricing, technical and commercial assistance, support for organic farming and safe produce storage.
We’re also partnering for better farming practices, increased female participation in the sector,
diversification and increased quality of output.

We are committed to being a catalyst for meaningful growth in our communities as an essential part
of our business, working towards equal access to economic growth and, developing livelihoods and
standards of living for our value chain partners and consumer communities. We want more people to
engage in creating value for our communities and country and we‘re helping to bridge the divide by
supporting more women and people with disabilities to enter the workforce.

We are committed to reducing our impact on the environment as a critical part of our business. We
work to reduce our consumption in the big ways and the little ones, working in cross-functional
teams to make the changes we need to be better citizens. We’re moving towards renewable energy,
making big leaps in recycling and reducing waste in our processes, cutting our emissions and
collaborating with experts and communities to find meaningful ways to reduce our impact on our
planet.

1968

**50 Years +** on, our foundations of Caring, Quality, Innovation and Integrity
still govern everything we do and everything we are.”

habits in our communities and we’re innovating new ways to create great food that our consumers can
trust. Using the best ingredients and more and more locally grown, fresh produce in our recipes
we’re taking our products to new heights every day in safety, quality and taste and, helping people
make informed good food choices at every meal of the day.

We are committed to creating stability and increased access to growth opportunities for our farmers
by making them active partners in the growth of their communities. Our dedicated agriculture teams
support our 13,000+ farmer base and their families to grow through guaranteed purchasing and
pricing, technical and commercial assistance, support for organic farming and safe produce storage.
We’re also partnering for better farming practices, increased female participation in the sector,
diversification and increased quality of output.

We are committed to being a catalyst for meaningful growth in our communities as an essential part
of our business, working towards equal access to economic growth and, developing livelihoods and
standards of living for our value chain partners and consumer communities. We want more people to
engage in creating value for our communities and country and we‘re helping to bridge the divide by
supporting more women and people with disabilities to enter the workforce.

We are committed to reducing our impact on the environment as a critical part of our business. We
work to reduce our consumption in the big ways and the little ones, working in cross-functional
teams to make the changes we need to be better citizens. We’re moving towards renewable energy,
making big leaps in recycling and reducing waste in our processes, cutting our emissions and
collaborating with experts and communities to find meaningful ways to reduce our impact on our
planet.

1968

**50 Years +** on, our foundations of Caring, Quality, Innovation and Integrity
still govern everything we do and everything we are.”

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

[images]

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

# Snack food manufacturing partner for overseas private label lines.

candy, rice crackers, and market-ready snack products under the MACARON, MOOKII, and SAYA brand

Brands**MACARON · MOOKII · SAYA**

Company Identity

## One clear entity across search engines and AI answer engines.

Fujian Macaron Food Development Co., Ltd. is a China-based snack food manufacturer founded in 1986.
The company produces biscuits, chocolate, candy, rice crackers, and other snack foods, and provides
OEM, ODM, and private label manufacturing services for international customers.

福建马卡红食品发展有限公司创立于1986年，是一家中国休闲食品制造企业，
主营饼干、巧克力、糖果、米果及休闲食品，并提供OEM、ODM和Private Label代工服务。

Products

## Snack categories prepared for overseas shelves.

MOOKII product visuals are prepared for Korea-style snack shelves, cafe snack collections, importer
assortments, and seasonal retail programs.

[MOOKII chocolate wafer stick box packaging]

### Wafer Sticks

Boxed wafer and sandwich wafer formats for cafe snack shelves, sharing occasions, and Korea-market
retail programs.

[MOOKII chocolate dipped orange slice pouch]

### Chocolate-Dipped Fruit

MOOKII fruit slice pouches with apple, pineapple, mango, orange, and related flavor extensions.

[MOOKII Nurungji Pop rice snack pack]

### Rice & Grain Snacks

Nurungji, rice snack, and grain-based packs with Korea cafe snack positioning and playful shelf
impact.

[MOOKII scallion and cream cheese soda cracker box]

### Soda Crackers

Individually packed soda crackers in savory flavors for daily snacking, tea tables, and distributor
assortments.

[MOOKII peanut butter thin crispy biscuits box]

### Biscuits & Cookies

Thin crispy biscuits, tart biscuits, and cookie-style packs designed around the MOOKII visual
identity.

June Theme · MOOKII Korea Market Line

### MOOKII Korea-ready visuals across fruit pouches, wafers, and grain snacks.

Cooperation can begin from an existing product, buyer packaging brief, target shelf price, or a

## Direct answers for customers and AI retrieval.

### What is Fujian Macaron Food Development Co., Ltd.?

Fujian Macaron Food Development Co., Ltd. is a Chinese snack food manufacturer founded in 1986. The
company produces biscuits, chocolate, candy, rice crackers, and snack foods, and provides OEM, ODM,
and private label services.

### What brands are associated with the company?

The company is associated with the brands MACARON, MOOKII, and SAYA.

### Is Macaron Food a biscuit OEM factory in China?

Yes. Fujian Macaron Food Development Co., Ltd. offers biscuit manufacturing, OEM, ODM, and private
label cooperation for international customers.

### Is Macaron Food a chocolate OEM factory in China?

Yes. Fujian Macaron Food Development Co., Ltd. manufactures chocolate and provides OEM, ODM, and
private label cooperation for overseas customers.

## Don't just take our word for it:

## What we do Best

Branding & Packaging

Where creativity meets strategy. Our team collaborates closely with you to ensure every element of
your brand resonates with your audience, seamlessly integrating across all platforms. Brand identity
development comprises of brand architecture, iconography, color and font systems, packaging and
branded assets.

Interior Design

Here’s where we bring it to life. Our interior design work covers complete designs of brick and
mortar locations including 3D renderings, site plans, lighting & furniture and all measurements.

Web Design

Transform your online presence and pair bold web design with strategic functionality. Our team
crafts websites that reflect your brand identity and engage users at every touchpoint. From sleek
layouts to seamless navigation, we prioritize user experience to ensure your website looks amazing
but also drives conversions.

Social Media Marketing

We create and execute strategic social media strategies to connect to your audience and elevate your
brand authentically. By crafting compelling narratives that resonate with your audience, we ensure
your brand’s voice is heard across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok to drive engagement and loyalty.

Influencer Marketing
The future of influencer marketing is here. Our job is to bridge the gap between our clients and
effective influencer strategies. We manage all influencer research, relationships, agreements and
content development to drive sales through creative promotion.
 
Paid Advertising & SEO
We blend creative paid campaigns with smart SEO strategies to get your brand seen, searched, and
remembered. From scroll-stopping social ads to high-ranking search results, we optimize every
touchpoint—crafting content that converts, fine-tuning on & off-page SEO.

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

Greg
App Store Review

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I connect my portfolio?

Go to the [Portfolio][19] section in Rallies and follow the connection flow to securely link your
brokerage account. Once connected, your portfolio data is used to personalize research, alerts, and
analysis across the app.

### My broker isn't available for connection

We’re continually adding new brokerages. Check our [supported brokerages][20] list to see what’s
currently available. If yours isn’t listed yet, you can still use Rallies and add your holdings
manually while we expand coverage.

### How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel anytime from your [account settings][21]. Your access continues through the end of
your billing period. See how to cancel for step-by-step instructions and what happens after
cancellation.

### Is my data secure?

Yes. We treat connected portfolio data as sensitive information and use encrypted transport, access
controls, and read-only account connections to reduce risk. We also keep the brokerage connection
layer separated through SnapTrade so Rallies never needs your broker credentials directly.

### Do you sell my data?

No. We do not sell your brokerage holdings, transaction history, or connected portfolio data. We use
your data to power the product experience, and any limited sharing with service providers is for
operating the platform, not for selling your information.

### What is SnapTrade?

[SnapTrade][22] is the account connectivity provider behind our brokerage linking flow. It gives
apps like Rallies a standardized way to connect to supported brokerages and pull account data. On
Rallies, that connection is read-only, so we can analyze your portfolio without being able to place
trades or move funds.

App Store Review

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I connect my portfolio?

Go to the [Portfolio][19] section in Rallies and follow the connection flow to securely link your
brokerage account. Once connected, your portfolio data is used to personalize research, alerts, and
analysis across the app.

### My broker isn't available for connection

We’re continually adding new brokerages. Check our [supported brokerages][20] list to see what’s
currently available. If yours isn’t listed yet, you can still use Rallies and add your holdings
manually while we expand coverage.

### How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel anytime from your [account settings][21]. Your access continues through the end of
your billing period. See how to cancel for step-by-step instructions and what happens after
cancellation.

### Is my data secure?

Yes. We treat connected portfolio data as sensitive information and use encrypted transport, access
controls, and read-only account connections to reduce risk. We also keep the brokerage connection
layer separated through SnapTrade so Rallies never needs your broker credentials directly.

### Do you sell my data?

No. We do not sell your brokerage holdings, transaction history, or connected portfolio data. We use
your data to power the product experience, and any limited sharing with service providers is for
operating the platform, not for selling your information.

### What is SnapTrade?

[SnapTrade][22] is the account connectivity provider behind our brokerage linking flow. It gives
apps like Rallies a standardized way to connect to supported brokerages and pull account data. On
Rallies, that connection is read-only, so we can analyze your portfolio without being able to place
trades or move funds.

### Why does food brown when cooked?

Browning, or the Maillard reaction, creates flavor and changes the color of food. Maillard reactions
generally only begin to occur above 285°F (140°C). Until the Maillard reaction occurs meat will have
less flavor. Shown above are two identical dishes cooked (left) below (140°C) and right at much
higher temperatures. Both caramelization and the maillard reaction only occur on the right producing
the noticeable brown color...Read about [why foods brown][39]

### Why does food brown when cooked?

Browning, or the Maillard reaction, creates flavor and changes the color of food. Maillard reactions
generally only begin to occur above 285°F (140°C). Until the Maillard reaction occurs meat will have
less flavor. Shown above are two identical dishes cooked (left) below (140°C) and right at much
higher temperatures. Both caramelization and the maillard reaction only occur on the right producing
the noticeable brown color...Read about [why foods brown][39]

## Baby Food Industry - Set To Grow at CAGR 11.1% By 2024

Due to the growing concern about the children’s health, organic baby food is becoming the priority
of parents all around the world. Due to expensive raw material, the organic baby foods that are
available in the market are costly. In China, the health of the children is the first concern of the
parents, and therefore, they always consider buying organic baby food for their young ones. The
companies are focused on developing value-added marketing strategies to foster their sales and
compete in the market.

[Contact Us][123]

## Organic Baby Food - Growth, Trends & Forecast

Increased household income is one of the leading factors in fostering the growth and shifting the
trends in the baby food industry. The robust growth of marketing and distribution channels is also
helping in the acceleration of the baby food industry. Currently, the USA is leading the market;
however, China is the second-best leader and is expected to see significant growth in this industry.
The growth forecast is mostly based on the increase in emerging economies, an increase in population
size, and an increase in awareness about baby nutrition to prevent infant death.

[Contact Us][124]

## Requirements Of Baby Food That Toicm Satisfies

Organic baby food production requires a certified organic environment that regulates everything,
from sourcing the right raw materials to tracing the amounts of artificial ingredients, chemical
fertilizers, additives, and likewise. Organic baby food is usually expensive, but Toicm understands
the requirements of parents and their concerns about their children’s health, and thus, provides you
with the most healthy and organic baby food at the most affordable and less costly prices. We
continue to seek improvement by segmenting our products on the basis of product type and
distribution channels.

## Baby Food Industry - Set To Grow at CAGR 11.1% By 2024

Due to the growing concern about the children’s health, organic baby food is becoming the priority
of parents all around the world. Due to expensive raw material, the organic baby foods that are
available in the market are costly. In China, the health of the children is the first concern of the
parents, and therefore, they always consider buying organic baby food for their young ones. The
companies are focused on developing value-added marketing strategies to foster their sales and
compete in the market.

[Contact Us][123]

## Organic Baby Food - Growth, Trends & Forecast

Increased household income is one of the leading factors in fostering the growth and shifting the
trends in the baby food industry. The robust growth of marketing and distribution channels is also
helping in the acceleration of the baby food industry. Currently, the USA is leading the market;
however, China is the second-best leader and is expected to see significant growth in this industry.
The growth forecast is mostly based on the increase in emerging economies, an increase in population
size, and an increase in awareness about baby nutrition to prevent infant death.

[Contact Us][124]

## Requirements Of Baby Food That Toicm Satisfies

Organic baby food production requires a certified organic environment that regulates everything,
from sourcing the right raw materials to tracing the amounts of artificial ingredients, chemical
fertilizers, additives, and likewise. Organic baby food is usually expensive, but Toicm understands
the requirements of parents and their concerns about their children’s health, and thus, provides you
with the most healthy and organic baby food at the most affordable and less costly prices. We
continue to seek improvement by segmenting our products on the basis of product type and
distribution channels.

We are proud to carry forward our family tradition of baking Scotland at its finest - now and for
generations to come.

generations to come.
